evidence_kind: Objective-C metadata plus bounded ARM64 disassembly; static only
observations: BackGroundFetchToSync tail-calls InternalCreateSync with unsigned int scene 12; no UIApplication foreground-only branch is present in its bounded body.

InternalCreateSync preserves native pause, initialization, existing event-ID and event-creation checks. If paused, it flags needSync and returns false. If an event already exists, scene 12 returns false without adding a new needSync request.

creatPBNewSyncEvent writes the supplied scene into NewSyncRequest, creates ProtobufCGIWrap CGI 138, and requests EventService CreateProtobufEvent:Flag: with flag 5. No scene-12/foreground exclusion is present in the examined body.
The BOOL result indicates event creation/busy state only; a true return is not evidence of completed synchronization or received messages.
NotifyToSync reuses m_uiSyncScene. LongLinkTimerSync only checks isGettingData then records setNeedSyncWithScene: (2 or 4), so neither is as explicit a one-shot background-fetch entry.

onServiceEnterBackground [0x105180aa4,0x105180d40) and onWillSuspend [0x105180ff8,0x105181294) have login guards and report BgFgRequest online mode 2/3 through EventService command 312. Their complete bodies do not invoke makeSyncPause/setSyncPaused or access m_bIsSyncPause. This bounded finding does not exclude other lifecycle observers.
constraints: Use current account native service, main-thread invocation and runtime ABI checks; revalidate account epoch, background execution eligibility and selected AI configuration before every call.
Prefer an outer isGettingData check plus native internal guards. Do not force resetGettingData, mutate event IDs/scene/pauses, or call makeSyncResume to defeat a native pause.
The examined methods contain no general timer scheduling or OS wake-up guarantee. Any polling interval is a product choice, not established by this static evidence.
unknowns: Whether iOS grants continuing execution to this app while background audio is active on the user device.
Whether network policy, EventService or server sync selectors defer fetching muted group data in the real background state.
Actual callback thread conventions and end-to-end latency under the user device and plugin combination; main-thread dispatch is the conservative integration choice.
Behavior on other WeChat builds; runtime selector/type absence must fail closed.
